subject: Science
title: Fast or slow
learningTarget: I can tell a fast change to the land from a slow one.
lessonSummary: Students sort changes to Earth's surface by how fast they happen, not by how big they are. Page 2 adds something that does not change the land at all.
trap: Sorting by size: a giant canyon feels like a fast change, and a small landslide feels slow.

pages.rule: Sort by how fast the land changes.
pages.notThis: Big does not mean fast. Think about time.
